title: S75 — Test: suite runtime + flakiness census (run_all 3x, CI gate proposal)
desc: NEW-OP STARTER. GOAL: run tests/run_all.py three times on an idle box; publish per-file durations, total time, and any flaky/failing test with a repro; propose (do NOT apply) a CI gate policy if gaps exist. WHY: a fast, trusted suite is the merge gate; timing and flakiness drift silently. EVIDENCE: reports/suite-health/<date>.md + raw logs + PUSHES row + formalcode line. BOUNDARIES: no test changes in this task — findings + proposal only; a reproducible failure gets a bug task with the log. Boundaries: no edits to shipping paths unless the task says so; no tuning on canonical seeds 1/2/3/4/53 (evaluation only); honest numbers — no 98/95 claims; captchaproject(s) off-limits.
